content: {"reasoning":"Retroactive authorization is no longer available, peer-to-peer review is not offered, and records submission and a necessity appeal have already been attempted. With a secondary payer available and COB order correct, billing secondary is the best next step; similar claims were paid after secondary billing in 1/1 cases versus 4/9 after necessity appeals. The full denial balance should not be transferred to the patient beyond contractual responsibility or written off before secondary coverage is pursued.","action":"bill_secondary"}
